name: lib/timeout
title: Timeout
summary: A deadline on any async operation, with cancellation: the TS operation receives an AbortSignal that aborts at the deadline; the Rust future is dropped.

ts.name: withTimeout
ts.summary: withTimeout(fn(signal), ms, label | {label, signal, sleep, onEvent}).

config.name: ms
config.rule: An integer >= 1 (a zero deadline is meaningless).

behaviour.rule: An operation of duration d under timeout t times out iff d >= t; the clock then reads t, else d. The deadline is armed (TS) or polled (Rust) first, so a tie goes to the deadline.
At the deadline the operation is cancelled: its AbortSignal aborts with the TimeoutError (TS); its future is dropped (Rust).
The deadline timer is always cleared: on success, on failure and when fn throws synchronously.
An outer signal (TS) aborts the operation and rejects with its reason.

gaps: Python lands in phase 2 (mzizi-registry#472): a .py sibling, the /v1/py/{name} route in mzizi-api-gateway and a PyPI package.
